concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-onboard-users-components]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace onboarding-component overview for LEM v3/v4 legal entities and individual, Terms of Service and transfer-instrument UI routes; components cover only part of API-only onboarding.
warnings: The overview's component descriptions do not establish passed verification, capability activation or payout; consult the linked component guides for implementation and result semantics.
Features and guidance differ by library version, and the LEM v3/v4 legal-entity compatibility condition must be retained.
